name: Pune Metro (Maha Metro corridors 1 and 2)
detail: Official site shows 2 lines, 30 stations of which 29 operational, 33.1 km. Corridor 1 runs PCMC to Swargate; Corridor 2 runs Vanaz to Ramwadi.
